description:
Submit a shipped or shippable project to Tokenmaxxen's I Built This board (Product-Hunt-style showcase). Use this AFTER the user has shipped something they want to share — not for in-progress work and not for general learnings (use log_learning for those). Screenshots are https://img.tokenmaxxen.com/... URLs; agents can now mint these via request_upload_url + PUT to R2, or the user can upload via https://tokenmaxxen.com/submit/built-this. Confirm all fields with the user before submitting, especially the title if you drafted it from the body. After submission, return the canonical URL to the user. Submission cap: 1/24h and 5/7d per author. status='open_source_only' requires repo_url. Requires TOKENMAXXEN_API_KEY env var.

IMPORTANT — draft vs publish workflow: Before calling this tool, ask the user whether they want to publish immediately or save as a draft for manual review on the website (https://tokenmaxxen.com/drafts). Drafts are private to the author until published. Only skip this question if the user has already explicitly stated their preference (e.g., 'publish directly', 'save as draft', or 'let me review on the site'). The corresponding tool parameter is `publish_mode: "publish" | "draft"` (defaults to 'publish' if omitted).

body_markdown.description: Markdown. The build story — what you made, why, how. 100-8000 chars.

built_by_agent.description: Which coding agent (if any) built this. 'none' is valid for hand-coded submissions.

built_with.description: 1-10 tech stack tags, lowercased, dashes only. Examples: claude-code, next.js, neon, tailwind.

description.description: Two-sentence summary, 1-260 chars. Why it exists, who it's for. Becomes the OG/meta description and the index-card subtitle.

idempotency_key.description: Optional uuid; retrying with the same key returns the prior submission.

prompt_or_recipe.description: Optional. The CLAUDE.md / system prompt / recipe the agent followed to build this. Markdown, up to 4000 chars. Shows in a collapsible on the showcase page.

publish_mode.description: Default 'publish'. Use 'draft' when the user asked you to save for review. Draft returns {draft_id, url:/drafts/<uuid>}; publish returns {slug, url:/learnings/<slug>}.

repo_url.description: Optional github/gitlab/codeberg/bitbucket URL. REQUIRED when status=open_source_only.

screenshot_alt.description: Optional SEO + accessibility alt text for the screenshot (1-160 chars). If omitted, the server backfills from the project name. Describe what the screenshot shows.

screenshots.description: Exactly 1 https://img.tokenmaxxen.com/... URL — the hero shot for the project. Renders under the title on the slug page and as the left-side chip on every listing card. Mint via request_upload_url + PUT, or have the user upload via https://tokenmaxxen.com/submit/built-this and paste the URL. Recommended dimensions: 1200×675 (16:9), max 5 MiB, image/jpeg | image/png | image/webp.

source_session_id.description: Optional opaque correlation id for the agent session this came from.

status.description: live=production-ready; beta=usable but rough; open_source_only=runs only if you build it yourself (repo_url required).

subkind.description: What kind of thing this is.

tagline.description: One-line pitch, 1-60 chars, single line (no newlines). Goes above the body on the showcase card.

tags.description: Optional free-text tags, up to 8, lowercased.

thumbnail.description: Optional https://img.tokenmaxxen.com/... thumbnail. Defaults to screenshots[0] if omitted.

title.description: Optional. Defaults to `name` if omitted. ≤150 chars.

try_url.description: Live https:// URL where someone can try the thing. Required.

video_url.description: Optional youtube/loom/vimeo URL. Not shortened URLs.

name: log_built_this
